newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 128 of May 21, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 128 of May 21, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

* Corrigendum to Commission Directive 92/19/EEC of 23 March 1992 amending Directive 66/401/EEC on the marketing of fodder plant seed (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 104 of 22 April 1992)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 899/97 of 20 May 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 898/97 of 20 May 1997 fixing the compensatory aid for bananas produced and marketed in the Community in 1996, the deadline for payment of the balance of that aid and the unit amount of advances for 1997 (Text with EEA relevance)

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 897/97 of 20 May 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 2826/92 laying down detailed implementing rules for the specific measures for supplying the French overseas departments with products from the egg, poultrymeat and rabbit sectors

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 896/97 of 20 May 1997 amending and rectifying Regulation (EC) No 1663/95 laying down detailed rules for the application of Regulation (EEC) No 729/70 regarding the procedure for the clearance of the accounts of the EAGGF Guarantee Section

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 895/97 of 20 May 1997 on the country nomenclature for the external trade statistics of the Community and statistics of trade between Member States (Text with EEA relevance) END OF DOCUMENT.
